title: Mastery survives the waking
notes: Weapon mastery now remembers banked progress, the current bar, and the one standing bloodstain across restarts. Reclaiming consumes the stain and returns its points in one save.
Temporary save failures retry without granting points again. If another session changes the saved mastery, this waking leaves that progress untouched and tells you to reopen the game.
This completes the mastery save path. Combat awards, mastery bars, and a world-visible bloodstain are still separate work; the pre-alpha world does not yet award combat mastery.
